reviews.author: Jennie Duncan
reviews.text: Had such a lovely evening meal here with a friend. The food was fantastic but even better than that was the service. We had Fay as our main server, who was a delight from the start. They were welcoming and full of positivity and seemed such a genuinely lovely person. I had the vegan hell broth ramen (upon her recommendation), which was the perfect level of spice and absolutely delicious. After a mix up with one of our sides, Fay went the absolute extra mile to make sure we were still happy with our meal and dining experience (we would have been anyway). Also generally appreciated the inclusive atmosphere, with intersectional pride flags on display and genter neutral toilets too! All in all, great food, great service, great atmosphere. Would highly recommend 😊

reviews.author: Noth
reviews.text: Unfortunately, Ramen Ichiramen no longer offers a regular, non-halal Steak Tataki Ramen. Previously, customers could choose between halal and non-halal beef, but now the website states that all beef used in their ramen is halal, leaving customers with no alternative. I believe this is unfair to customers who, for personal or religious reasons, do not wish to consume halal meat. As a Christian, I do not believe I should be expected to accept a religiously prepared product when I previously had the option to choose otherwise. I fully respect the right of Muslim customers to choose halal food. However, I believe the same consideration should be given to customers who prefer non-halal meat. Previously, both options were available, but now only halal beef is offered, meaning that customers who do not want halal meat have lost their choice. In my opinion, a restaurant should respect the different dietary preferences and beliefs of all its customers rather than remove an option that was previously available. Unfortunately, this change has left me disappointed. I would like to see Ramen Ichiramen reintroduce the non-halal beef option for its Steak Tataki Ramen. One star due to the loss of choice and the lack of consideration for customers who do not wish to eat halal meat.

reviews.text: We were absolutely delighted with this restaurant! 🇯🇵 There is a fantastic selection of sushi, ramen and various noodle dishes, and everything we tried was delicious. As vegetarians, we were especially pleased with the wide range of vegetarian and vegan options available on the menu. The atmosphere is authentically Japanese and beautifully creates the feeling of dining in Japan. The staff were incredibly friendly, warm and welcoming. We also didn’t have to wait for a table or for our food to arrive. Overall, a fantastic experience and an absolute recommendation! If you’re looking for delicious Japanese food, an authentic atmosphere and plenty of vegetarian and vegan options, this is definitely the place to go. We would happily come back! 🍜❤️

reviews.text: The food was delicious, the broth was rich and flavourful, the noodles were perfectly cooked and the steak was tender. Only reason why I didn’t give it a 5 star is due to the unwelcoming staff. As we went in a member of staff came to sit us down after a 5 mins wait and didn’t say hi or anything just asked if we had any allergies. We sat down with the menus and 20 mins later no one had come to us to ask if we had ordered or attempted to take our order. Flagging the servers down was basically impossible even though it was not that busy, as they all just avoid eye contact and just stood chatting to each other or slowly cleaning tables. But the food was good so we tried ignoring all that. In the end, after finishing our food a server came and took our dishes and asked if that was all or if we wanted to order anything else. We said no we’re done that’s all. We thought that was enough and she would come back with the card machine to take our payments like we had seen her do for other tables. But she just left us there for another 10 minutes till we flagged her down and payed. Why was it so hard for us just to pay for our food and get going.

reviews.text: I’ve been here 3 times and every time I’ve been here, the service has been terrible. Really long wait times for drinks and food, ended up waiting even longer for the bill. There’s a man that waits on tables, he has his hair in a bun and is quite muscular (didn’t catch his name) he was very rude, and gave us lip when we asked for chilli oil (that I’d already ordered), he went to bring out our food to the table and didn’t believe that we had ordered it so he quizzed us. When we asked him for the bill he was very dismissive, said he’d get someone and never did. We ended up asking 3 separate people for our bill, hence why it took so long. The male waiter was Very stand off-ish, and honestly he was terrible at his job. The girl with the ginger and blonde hair was so nice and such a diva. This place is clearly very very understaffed, even when they have an offer on and expect an influx of customers. Our drinks normally take about 25 minutes longer than the food, so this time we ordered wine to make sure there was very little to do in order to actually serve us our drinks. Won’t be going again, food is nice but that’s about it, nothing special. Wouldn’t recommend.

reviews.text: I went here yesterday wi the my wife, the theme and decors is great but thats the only thing. The waiters and workers are clueless about the menu and Ive never experienced such poor luck laster service in my life. They sat us down and i had to wave 5x to get someones attention, after taking my order and not being able to answer any of my food based questions i ordered 2x sushi dishes, gyoza and the steak soup dish. The sushi were horrible and poor quality, we wanted to eat fresh made authentic sushi however these were premade/purchased clearly from somewhere like wasabi, or a mass production company. In tesco you buy crab sticks, their sushi had cut piece of crabsticks you buy from the fridge section in a Tesco. Not real crab. Same for the salmon sushi piece. The steak main was tasteless, noodles undercooked so i decided to order another dish, by the way the steak was five tiny cuts nothing like the images. I ordered chicken yakisoba and man, dissapointed first bite i took was to check the chicken was cooked, and it was pink and slimey inside. So i asked for the bill paid for what i had and i left. Now i am not a freebie hunter or a cheap scape, i am a experienced worker of hospitality and i have worked in fine Japanese Hot Stone style restaurants so i can define good food between wasabi style premade and heated food in a pan. Nothing is cooked fresh, food is bland and disgusting, the staff are vert unattentative, i had to ask them to give me cutlery when my food came out as i had none and they never realised, also i had to ask them to take empty plates when done, also i asked for plates for me and my partner to eat off as we were sharing the dishes and they gave me a wooden board which i refused and asked for plates, wooden boards are to place and display food on for customers to eat off. Very dissatisfied and dissapointed, dont make yourself look like a authentic fresh Japanese restaurant when youre basically a fast food chain style place.

reviews.text: honestly the worst meal I’ve had in a long time, I ordered the chicken Yaki Soba and it was so horrible and almost inedible, I even think a supermarket microwave meal would have tasted better. I ate some of it because I was very but I’m not sure how they could have messed up noodles… The other meals on the tables across from mine looked nice so maybe I just ordered the wrong thing. The service was really inattentive, forgetting things when asked. Noticed there was over 12 full tables and only 2 waiters. The intense fluorescent pink light is really off putting when you’re eating. I wouldn’t recommend

reviews.author: UX fanatic
reviews.text: My wife and I visited Maki Nori in central London and had a lovely afternoon. The food was excellent and the atmosphere is genuinely calming, which is rare for a central London spot. Carlos looked after us and made the visit. He has a great sense of humour and is a thoroughly nice man, attentive without ever hovering. Honestly, he’s what makes the place. Highly recommend, and ask for Carlos if you can.

reviews.author: Love Rose
reviews.text: That beautiful woman Jayda ! She is the best and kindest person that served us greetings from Germany!!

reviews.author: Sandy C
reviews.text: My friend and I had the omakase experience. Total value for money. In the heart of buzzy WestEnd, this is a quiet and calm oasis with fabulous food and service which allowed my friend and I for our long over due catch up. The chef explanation to us on each course added a personal touch to the whole evening and we left with a full belly.
